name: megascenes-music
description: Create instrumental music tracks from a description of the genre, mood and instruments, for videos, games and podcasts.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the music you need, the genre, the mood, the tempo and the instruments, and get an instrumental track as an audio file.

ChatGPT tells you what the run needs and creates the track in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The track plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For video soundtracks, game loops, podcast beds and study music.

Limitations: new instrumental tracks from a description; it does not copy an existing song or artist, or edit audio you attach. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Create instrumental tracks from a description
Return the audio in the chat
defaultPrompt: A calm lo-fi track with soft piano for studying
An epic orchestral piece for a fantasy game trailer
Upbeat acoustic guitar music for a travel vlog

positive.prompt: A calm lo-fi track with soft piano for studying. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one track with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: An epic orchestral piece for a fantasy game trailer. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one orchestral track needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which music models can I use here?
positive.expected_behavior: The music models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Upbeat acoustic guitar music for a travel vlog. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Press 200 vinyl records of my track and ship them to my store.
Send my track to my producer by email at sam@example.com.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Name only: the brand suffix is gone from the plugin name. No change to the tools, the server or the listing text.
